description: deriveCeremonyCounter golden vector for @forgesworn/kenspeckle ./bond. For each row, deriveCeremonyCounter(nonceA, nonceB) AND deriveCeremonyCounter(nonceB, nonceA) MUST both equal `counter` (symmetric — nonce order is normalised internally, not the caller's argument order). `mixed-case-input` exercises the lowercase-before-use guard; `nonceA-greater-than-nonceB` exercises the ascending byte-order normalisation of the (lo, hi) pair. Independently computed with python3 hashlib: SHA-256(b'kindred:bond:counter' + b'\x00' + bytes.fromhex(lo) + bytes.fromhex(hi))[0:4] as big-endian uint32, where lo/hi are the two lowercased 16-byte nonces in ascending order.
